verdict.rationale: The evidence implies an incident timeline exists. AI-drafted retrospectives analyze the incident and produce drafts that include timelines, and the Scribe and Zoom AI capture discussions and decisions from incident bridges. Responders can post notes and updates via `/fh update` or Command Center, and retrospectives support collaborative editing of incident fields. However, no doc directly describes an automatically captured timeline of alerts, runbook actions and Slack decisions, or editing and annotating timeline entries after the fact. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic timeline capture from alerts, actions and chat; documented post-incident editing or annotation of timeline entries; independent or hands-on corroboration.
